Title: Analyst, Analytics, Data Science
Description: Rise is an award-winning , full-service Media Agency of Record that is backed by data and powered by people. We create omnichannel experiences using our proprietary tech stack and advanced analytics capabilities to help solve the unique struggles brands face today. This approach, with transparency at its core , specializes in omnichannel media, commerce and retail media, advanced in-home media, as well as content and creator marketing. We offer "Risers" the opportunity to work in an ever-evolving industry that will foster learning and development, provide an innovative work environment with diverse projects and clients, career advancement paths a collaborative team environment, corporate social responsibility initiatives, an inclusive and diverse culture, plus association with a reputable media agency. We're looking for talent like you who can continue to elevate our work and culture. GENERAL PURPOSE OF JOB As a Data Scientist on Quad's Insights and Analytics team, you will play an important role in driving the effectiveness of media campaigns through advanced data analysis. You will be responsible for executing modeling projects using a variety of home-grown and 3 rd -party tools.This includes data cleansing, formatting, loading, execution, model evaluation, and result reviews.In collaboration with the broader team, you will help craft the insights from these models and turn those insights into recommendations for our clients.Throughout the process, we expect you to seek ways to improve the processes. Location: Mexico City, 3 days in office; Applicants must hold Mexican citizenship Key Responsibilities Model Execution: Load, execute, and refine statistical and machine learning models to assess and improve media effectiveness. Develop processes and data pipelines to support media planning and optimization. Data Analysis: Conduct thorough analyses of media performance data, including engagement metrics, conversion rates, and ROI. Identify trends, patterns, and insights to inform media strategy. Insights Generation: Translate complex data findings into clear, actionable insights. Prepare detailed reports and visualizations that communicate the impact and effectiveness of media strategies. Collaboration: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including media planners, marketing strategists, and data engineers, to ensure alignment of data insights with overall media strategy. Continuous Improvement: Stay curious about the latest industry trends and advancements in data science and media analytics. Propose and implement improvements to existing models and methodologies. Job Requirements Proven experience in data science, particularly in building and deploying predictive, explanatory, or decomposition models. Strong proficiency in statistical analysis and machine learning techniques. Experience with data visualization tools and techniques for effective communication of insights. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex data clearly and understandably. Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team. Good English proficiency, recognizing that your manager is bilingual and will aid where necessary. Education Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field. A Master's degree or higher is preferred. Experience Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in data science or analytics, with a focus on media effectiveness, marketing analytics, or related areas. Experience working in an agency or client-facing role is a plus. Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Technical Skills: Proficiency in programming languages such as Python or R. Experience with data manipulation and analysis libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy) and machine learning frameworks (e.g., Scikit-learn, TensorFlow), mathematical and statistical modeling, Bayesian methods, optimization techniques, and simulation. Data Tools: Expertise in SQL for querying databases, and familiarity with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or similar. Analytical Thinking: Strong analytical and critical thinking skills to interpret data and develop actionable insights. Communication: Ability to convey complex data insights and technical information to non-technical stakeholders. Time Management: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines. Collaboration: Strong team player with experience working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Marketing Interest and Initiative: Strong interest in marketing and a proactive attitude toward learning new concepts, tools, and strategies, with the initiative to apply knowledge and contribute to business objectives.

TechStack: Python, R, Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, SQL, Tableau, Power BI

Title: Manager, Commercial Performance Analytics.
Description: Work Location Assignment: Mexico City, must be able to work from assigned Pfizer office 2-3 days per week , or as needed by the business. Role Summary Commercial Analytics harnesses the power of data to drive robust analytical insights that inform some of Pfizer’s most critical business questions. With colleagues across the globe, the Commercial Analytics team’s rigorous analytical expertise is depended on as the compass for decision support across the enterprise. Our dynamic, exciting team of subject-matter experts comes from diverse backgrounds and experiences, including data science, commercial analytics, finance, market research, and consulting. As a team, we collaborate to turn data into meaningful insights that will have a direct impact on patients’ lives and the future of Pfizer as a data-driven organization. We are seeking a Manager, Commercial Performance Analytics to serve as a hands-on individual contributor within our Mexico City analytics capability center, building the datasets, pipelines, and analytical assets that power performance tracking and insight generation for the commercial organization. This role designs and automates scalable analytics solutions in SQL, Python, and R, while partnering closely with US-based Performance Analytics and Insights (PAI) colleagues as its primary point of collaboration. Working from PAI-defined priorities, the successful candidate will help standardize and centralize the commercial analytics and reporting ecosystems and implement industry best practices in performance analytics and insight-generation processes. This role is dynamic, fast-paced, highly collaborative, and covers a broad range of strategic topics that are critical to our business. The successful candidate will join Global Commercial Analytics (GCA) colleagues worldwide who are dedicated to driving business through proactive thought leadership, innovative technical capabilities, and the ability to communicate complex and dynamic information in new and creative ways. Role Responsibilities Technical Development & Analytics Solutions Design, develop, and maintain scalable analytics solutions using SQL, Python, R, and related technologies. Build, optimize, and automate datasets, data pipelines, and reporting frameworks to support commercial performance measurement. Engineer and integrate data from multiple internal and external sources to create robust analytical datasets. Develop and maintain high-quality analytical assets, including dashboards, reporting tools, and reusable code libraries. Improve performance, reliability, and scalability of existing analytics workflows through automation and process optimization. Leverage AI, scripting, and emerging analytical technologies to increase efficiency and analytical capabilities. Analysis & Insight Generation Perform advanced analyses on patient, HCP, payer, and commercial datasets to identify trends, opportunities, and risks. Apply statistical, quantitative, and machine learning techniques to solve business problems and generate actionable insights. Conduct data quality assessments, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure accuracy and consistency of analytical outputs. Translate complex analytical findings into clear insights supported by quantitative evidence. Collaboration & Partnership Partner closely with US-based PAI colleagues as the primary point of collaboration, supporting shared analytics priorities and delivering against team-defined requirements. Translate information needs surfaced by PAI leads into robust analytical solutions, connecting datasets to tell a clear, compelling story backed by quantitative evidence. Work with PAI and broader analytic functions to advance the use of novel data sources and improve reporting processes, tools, and standards. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in a quantitative discipline such as computer science, engineering, economics, statistics or related field. 5+ years of experience in Biopharma, analytics, strategic healthcare consulting, or related fields. Extensive expertise in SQL, Python, R, or similar; other object-oriented programming languages. Advanced knowledge of scripting tool and creation of AI agents for automation. Understanding of data visualization tools and experience designing and building complex dashboards, including but not limited to Tableau, PowerBI, Qlik and similar. Analytics, statistics and/or database knowledge and experience (using tools, applications, platforms, etc.). Hands on experience in data types/formats, data architecture, pipeline/ETL optimization Knowledge of data cloud platforms like Snowflake preferred. Strong Project Management Skills: Overseeing complex, cross-functional projects, ensuring delivery on time and within budget. Collaboration: Ability to prioritize, and developing action plans. Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Recent Healthcare Life Sciences (pharma preferred) and ecosystem professional industry experience is preferred; commercial analytics experience is a plus. EEO (Equal Employment Opportunity) & Employment Eligibility Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, or disability. To learn more about acceptable and prohibited uses of AI during the recruitment process, please review our candidate AI-use guidelines available on Pfizer Careers. Marketing and Market Research

Title: Business Intelligence Manager
Description: Work Your Magic with us! Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us. United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe. Your Role At the intersection of commercial strategy and cutting-edge technology, this role is your opportunity to shape how data-driven intelligence powers healthcare decisions across the affiliate. As Manager, Business Intelligence, Data Science & AI, you will lead the design and delivery of analytics capabilities — from executive dashboards and predictive models to AI-powered automation tools — that directly accelerate commercial performance and strategic decision-making. You will own the end-to-end Business Intelligence agenda, integrating diverse data sources to generate insights that matter, and translating complex analytical findings into compelling narratives for senior leadership. Operating with considerable autonomy, you will define priorities, develop policies, and build solutions that position the affiliate at the forefront of commercial analytics in the pharmaceutical industry. This is a role for someone who combines deep technical expertise with strong business acumen and the ability to influence at the highest levels of the organization. Who You Are You hold a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Economics, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Analytics, or Business Administration is preferred. You bring 5 to 8 or more years of experience in Business Intelligence within the pharmaceutical industry, with a strong track record in commercial analytics, market research, and supporting Marketing, Sales, and Leadership teams. You are proficient in Power BI, advanced Excel, statistical modelling, and machine learning fundamentals for building predictive and prescriptive analytics solutions. Experience in Python and SQL is a plus. You have hands-on experience developing AI agents, Generative AI solutions, and automation tools — including familiarity with large language model orchestration frameworks and responsible AI governance principles. You demonstrate the ability to integrate and synthesize multiple commercial data sources — including syndicated market data, CRM platforms, digital analytics, and financial data — into coherent, actionable insights. You communicate with clarity and confidence, translating complex analytical outputs into strategic narratives for executive audiences, and collaborating effectively across commercial, medical, and digital functions. You demonstrate AI literacy — including a working understanding of how artificial intelligence technologies function, their practical business applications, ethical considerations such as bias and data privacy, and the governance frameworks that ensure responsible use in a commercial healthcare context. You are fluent in Spanish (native level) and have advanced business-level proficiency in English. What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress! Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

Diagnosticar dónde se pierde valor, cuantificar el tamaño de cada oportunidad y mantener un Control Tower con CAC, payback, LTV y Gross Profit por canal, levantando alertas cuando algo se desvía de la tesis Resolución de problemas estratégicos (tu día a día estilo consultoría): estructurar problemas ambiguos en análisis accionables — descomponer una caída de ventas en tasa × ticket × volumen, diagnosticar un funnel SDR, dimensionar un canal nuevo con un business case Pricing & elegibilidad (con Riesgo): modelar bandas de precio/score-cut y diseñar/leer experimentos A/B que equilibren aprobación y margen Research de cliente: entrevistas, jobs-to-be-done e insights de mercado que se traducen en ofertas, mensajes y apuestas de segmento De la recomendación a la ejecución: bajar la estrategia a instrumentos operables — playbooks de Outbound, lead scoring, territories, listas activables (AI/enrichment), briefs de Digital — y coordinar handoffs con SDR/AE, Marketing y Growth Cadencia operativa: preparar y facilitar WBR/MBR. Si actualmente estás en Chile pero tienes disponibilidad para mudarte a Ciudad de México, esta oportunidad puede ser para ti. Nuestros Beneficios: 🌴 Xepelin Balance Vacaciones: 15 días hábiles. Matrimonio plus: Lleva tus planes al siguiente nivel, con una gift card y extendiendo tu permiso legal por matrimonio con dos días de regalo por Xepelin. Estas herramientas asisten a nuestro equipo de reclutamiento, pero no reemplazan al criterio humano. Las decisiones finales de contratación son tomadas, en última instancia, por personas. Title: Data Engineer - Music DISCO, Music DISCO
Description: Description Amazon Music is awash in data! We build and maintain automated self-service data solutions, data science models and deep dive difficult questions that provide actionable insights. We also enable measurement, personalization and experimentation by operating key data programs ranging from attribution pipelines, northstar weblabs metrics to causal frameworks. (ii) delivering exceptional Analytics & Science infrastructure for DISCO teams, fostering a data-driven approach to insights and decision making. As platform builders, we are committed to constructing flexible, reliable, and scalable solutions to empower our customers. (iii) accelerates and facilitates content analytics and provides independence to generate valuable insights in a fast, agile, and accurate way. This domain provides analytical support for the Consumer Product Tech org to make data driven decisions while launching new features and evaluating existing features with the end goal of improving the customer experience. DISCO team enables repeatable, easy, in depth analysis of music customer behaviors. We reduce the cost in time and effort of analysis, data set building, model building, and user segmentation. Our goal is to empower all teams at Amazon Music to make data driven decisions and effectively measure their results by providing high quality, high availability data, and democratized data access through self-service tools. If you love the challenges that come with big data then this role is for you. We collect billions of events a day, manage petabyte scale data on Redshift and S3, and develop data pipelines using Spark/Scala EMR, SQL based ETL, Airflow services. We are looking for talented, enthusiastic, and detail-oriented Data Engineer, who knows how to take on big data challenges in an agile way. Duties include big data design and analysis, data modeling, and development, deployment, and operations of big data pipelines. You'll help build Amazon Music's most important data pipelines and data sets, and expand self-service data knowledge and capabilities through an Amazon Music data university. DISCO team develops data specifically for a set of key business domains like personalization and marketing and provides and protects a robust self-service core data experience for all internal customers. We deal in AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, EMR, EC2, DynamoDB, Kinesis Firehose, and Lambda. Your team will manage the data exchange store (Data Lake) and EMR/Spark processing layer using Airflow as orchestrator. You'll build our data university and partner with Product, Marketing, BI, and ML teams to build new behavioural events, pipelines, datasets, models, and reporting to support their initiatives. You'll also continue to develop big data pipelines. Key job responsibilities You will work with Product Managers, Data scientists and other Data Engineers to help design, develop and deliver scalable data analytics platform and data pipeline solutions to support various Science, ML initiatives and at the scale and speed of Amazon Music. In addition, you will help design, develop, and deliver components for the analytics platform at the broader org level and streamline/automate workflows for the broader DISCO organization. A day in the life Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, data scientists, business intelligence engineers, to design and architect a modern data analytics platform on AWS, utilizing the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK). Develop robust and scalable data pipelines using SQL/PySpark/Airflow to efficiently ingest, process, and transform large volumes of data from various sources into a structured format, ensuring data quality and integrity. Design and implement an efficient and scalable data warehousing solution on AWS, using appropriate NoSQL/SQL storage and database technologies for structured and unstructured data. Automate ETL/ELT processes to streamline data integration from diverse data sources and ensure the platform's reliability and efficiency. Create data models to support business intelligence, providing actionable insights and interactive reports to end-users. Enable advanced analytics and machine learning capabilities within the platform to derive predictive and prescriptive insights from the data through tools like EMR/SageMaker Notebooks Continuously monitor and optimize the performance of data pipelines, databases, and applications, ensuring low-latency data access for analytics and machine learning tasks. Implement robust security measures and ensure data compliance with internal requirements, industry standards, and regulations to safeguard sensitive information. Work closely with data scientists and business intelligence engineers to understand their requirements and collaborate on data-related projects. Create comprehensive technical documentation for the platform's architecture, data models, and APIs to facilitate knowledge sharing and maintainability. Title: Especialista de Siniestros

Evidencia de haber llevado iniciativas desde el diagnóstico hasta la implementación, adopción y medición de resultados. Experiencia colaborando con líderes de distintas áreas, administrando prioridades en conflicto e influyendo sin autoridad jerárquica. En AXA, celebramos la diversidad de ideas y pensamientos, porque nos hace más fuertes. Promovemos un entorno inclusivo, sustentable y lleno de espacios para aprender, colaborar y crear. Aquí, cada idea cuenta, cada voz es valorada y tu desarrollo es nuestra misión. No hacemos ningún tipo de discriminación, ni solicitamos certificados médicos de VIH o no embarazo. Si quieres dar el siguiente paso y atreverte a hacer lo mejor de ti, AXA México te está esperando. Atrévete a vivir la experiencia AXA y construye un futuro lleno de oportunidades.

Description: Who We Are About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. About The Team Deal Pricing is a dedicated global function that provides deal pricing expertise, financial insights and deal support for negotiated users to Stripe’s global Go-to-Market teams. We work to ensure deals create economic value for Stripe by establishing the deal commercial framework for a scaling sales organization, actively supporting large and strategic deals and providing pricing insights and feedback to sales, finance and product leaders. Deal Pricing frequently works with cross-functional business partners across Operations, Finance & Strategy and Product and there is constant collaboration with Deal Pricing colleagues across all regions. AMER Deal Pricing covers teams in the United States, Canada and Latin America and are located in Stripe offices and remote locations across the region. What You’ll Do You will be instrumental in providing thought leadership to regional sales teams and senior executives and continuing to develop our framework, approach and associated processes in order to achieve mutually beneficial deals with our sold Users while mitigating risk to Stripe. In addition to providing key financial insights and recommendations to business partners and Stripe leadership, you will have a chance to stretch beyond the boundaries of finance through business case development and commercial negotiations with all types of customers across the full suite of Stripe’s financial and payment products. Responsibilities Serve as a key financial and strategic thought partner to specific AMER Go-to-Market sales teams and their leadership in both pricing deals at scale and pricing strategic deals Be responsible for defining and implementing our pricing and margin guidance and identifying levers for financial uplift Develop and refine new frameworks to evaluate a deal’s attractiveness to Stripe, ensuring alignment between these frameworks, the company’s long range plan and mutually agreeable outcomes with cross-functional business partners Maintain up to date pricing benchmarks and contribute to team analytical design and production efforts, using this data to enhance our pricing philosophy Who You Are We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum Requirements Minimum 3+ years of experience in finance or deal pricing at a company, or experience within investment banking or, management consulting A proven ability to build collaborative working relationships with business partners through a combination of influencing and awareness The ability to deal effectively with ambiguity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment by driving business results without significant supervision Excellent financial modeling, verbal and written communication skills Preferred Qualifications Experience in the payments or technology sector Experience presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership, preferably to sales of go-to-market business partners Experience with SQL and Tableau or a willingness to learn is a must In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now

Title: Data Analytics Specialist — Settlement
Description: About The Company DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services. DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future. For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news About The Team/role We are a startup inside DiDi. We are building a completely new logistics supply model for food delivery in Mexico — not optimizing something that already works, but figuring out from scratch what should exist. Everything here is 0 to 1: the partner network, the pricing logic, the target system, the settlement infrastructure. Most of it did not exist eighteen months ago. Some of it does not exist yet. That means the answers are not in a playbook. There is no team down the hall who solved this last year. You will define the metric before you can hit it, build the mechanism before you can run it, and be wrong in public often enough to learn fast. The work is genuinely hard, and the ambiguity is real — but so is the ownership. Decisions here are made by the people doing the work, and they show up in the numbers within weeks. We have the backing of a company that operates at scale, and the pace and freedom of a team that is still writing its own rules. That combination is rare, and it is the reason this team exists. We are looking for people who want to win — who are drawn to unsolved problems rather than defined ones, who move fast without getting sloppy, and who would rather build the system than work inside someone else's. If you have ever looked at a broken process and thought I could fix this if someone would just let me — this is that job. Come build it with us. In this role, you'll be... Settlement cycle ownership Own the end-to-end settlement cycle for Vendor partners: translate pricing and incentive rules into calculation logic, produce statements on schedule, and drive the payment process through to completion. Guarantee accuracy. Reconcile order-level data against pricing rules and Finance records before release, and own the dispute and adjustment process end to end. Maintain full traceability: every line on a statement should be reproducible from source data. Billing analysis Break down settlement cost by vendor, city, zone, tier, and order type each cycle, and explain month-over-month movement — separating volume effects, rate effects, rule changes, and errors. Surface structural issues, not just line-item discrepancies. Examples: revenue attributed to the wrong budget pool, incentives double-counted, pricing rules that misfire on edge cases. Provide the cost inputs Operations needs to make pricing and supply-structure decisions. Pricing rule implementation and control Convert pricing, incentive, and commercial term changes into settlement logic before they go live; pressure-test edge cases and quantify the cost impact in advance. Maintain a versioned single source of truth for settlement rules. Build automated validation and anomaly detection so errors surface before a statement is issued, not after a partner disputes it. Finance partnership and compliance Work with Finance on accruals, budget pools, invoice (factura) matching, and tax documentation; support month-end close and audit requests. Ensure settlement records meet local compliance and documentation requirements. Automation and AI Move the settlement process from manual to automated: reduce cycle time, manual touch points, and single-person dependency. Apply AI tools to reconciliation, anomaly detection, document handling, and analysis production. We're eager to be in touch because you have... Must have Fluent English (proficient level, working language) — daily use for cross-regional reporting, Finance alignment, and written analysis. 5+ years of work experience. Strong data analysis capability (hard requirement) — SQL and large-scale transaction-level data handling; able to independently pull, reconcile, and attribute without relying on BI support. Comfortable working with millions of rows and finding the one that's wrong. Proficient with AI tools (hard requirement) — applied in daily work for reconciliation, anomaly detection, document handling, and analysis production, with concrete examples of workflows you have rebuilt. Excellent business sense — able to look at a number and know whether it is plausible, and know where to look when it isn't. High rigor and accountability. Settlement errors are externally visible and expensive; this role requires someone who double-checks by instinct. Plus Accounting or finance background — significant plus. Familiarity with accruals, reconciliation, month-end close, and audit requirements. Familiarity with Mexican tax and invoicing (RFC, CFDI, factura). Spanish. Experience with vendor/supplier settlement, franchise payouts, or gig-economy courier payment systems. Python or other automation skills; BI tool proficiency. You'll love working at DiDi because... We create user value We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient. We are data-driven We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics. Win-win Collaboration Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do. We believe in integrity Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other. Growth We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow. Diversity and Inclusion Diversity is one of our biggest strengths.
